blocks.text: Let's send your first message! Gemini is an AI made by the company Google.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Together with a parent, open gemini.google.com or the Gemini app.
Write your question in normal sentences.
Press the send button and wait for the answer.

blocks.text: The more details you give, the better the answer. Say what you're curious about and how old you are, so the AI explains it the right way for you.
Hi! I'm 12. Tell me 3 interesting facts about octopuses, each in one sentence.

items: You can ask more: "Tell me more about the second fact".
If you don't understand something, write: "Explain it more simply".
For a new topic, start a new chat.
